tweets.text: Alibaba bans Claude Code from all workplaces starting July 10, citing backdoor security risks. Replacement: Qoder, its own AI coding tool. Worth noting: Anthropic doesn't officially serve users in China. The ban itself confirms Alibaba had been tolerating unauthorized usage. [image]
